page.notes: Marginal notes read: "Ea ratione Papa Christi æmulus Collegium Apostolicum ex Cardinalibus conflatum constituit." and "Cardinalium ex eo tempore prærogativæ multiplices." The Greek phrase after "Papa" is printed as transcribed and is uncertain. The heading LXXVI and LXXII are numbered paragraph markers, not true headings; the printed "LXXVI." and "LXXII." are set in the text lines. "multiplices" in the margin may be a printing error for "multiplicatæ". The "Orbem" line is set in the last line of the verse quotation. Final word "in" is a catchword.
